object.attr: stakeholder: a half-applied change, a delete that stripped some incoming links and not others for example, leaves documents inconsistent. Fixed in 0.3.0; undo relies on the same unit. Discard and resolving a merge aren't journaled and finish when run again (MELLON-VER-SRS; CF-S35).
object.description: If a file can't be written or deleted during a GUI operation that edits a document, Mellon shall return each file the operation already wrote or deleted to its state before the operation.
